docs.summary: What the renderer drew last frame and how long frames take, for stats overlays and performance captures. Call [`EndFrame`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.Rendering.RenderStats~EndFrame) once a frame; [`Last`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.Rendering.RenderStats~Last) holds the counts of the last frame the renderer recorded.
The most recent frame's counts. Safe for UI to read.
Ring buffer of recent frame times (ms) for plotting. Length = 120.
Current write index in the history ring buffer.
Takes the renderer's counts of its last frame and this frame's time.
